name: multi-company-portal
description: Multi-company login portal that hosts the FinTrack financial app per tenant, with master/staff accounts.
whatsNew: The Owner view now shows a clear "read-only" notice while looking at a company's dashboard, and a proper error if a save is ever blocked — instead of the screen quietly pretending it worked.
New "Owner" login for a boss who oversees several companies: one card per company with today's deposits, withdrawals, Win/Loss and the Store balance.
Tapping a company's card opens its real dashboard for a closer look — view-only, so an owner login can never add or edit a company's data.
